# Soft Paper

Soft Paper keeps a reflective, soft-paper look while slimming its CSS for speed. The description records a reduced theme size and the removal of CPU-heavy animations, aimed at responsiveness when several vaults are open. Optional Style Settings toggles add compact layouts and subtle UI adjustments.

![Soft Paper screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nickmilo/soft-paper/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Soft Paper"
    author: "nickmilo"
    repo:   "nickmilo/soft-paper"
    slug:   "soft-paper"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/soft-paper"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/nickmilo/soft-paper"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nickmilo/soft-paper/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a reflective, soft-paper visual that preserves a calm aesthetic while slimming CSS for speed. Reduced theme size and remove CPU-heavy animations to keep Obsidian snappy, especially with multiple vaults open. Enable optional Style Settings toggles for compact layouts and subtle UI tweaks."
}
```
